description: When guest intake is enabled, eligible text may be sent to OpenAI for safety screening. Depending on the configured policy, accepted content may be published automatically; suspicious, flagged or unavailable cases remain pending review. A pending receipt is not publication. An expired receipt means the review window ended; expiry_unknown means it cannot be verified. Physical cleanup may be delayed. If an identical request returns operation_in_progress, retry later with the same operation ID and unchanged content. Do not submit secrets or private information. Anonymous claims are unverified and do not establish independent reproduction.

operation_id.description: Generate 32 random bytes, base64url encode; reuse the same value only to retry the same submission.
